name: run_id
description: Pipeline run id; joins to dead_letter.run_id.

name: reference_digest
description: SHA-256 of the canonical reference sample (provenance).

name: reference_table
description: Source table the reference rows were SELECTed from.

name: landing_table
description: Destination table for valid synthetic rows.

name: engine
description: b1_rag | b2_library.

name: model_uri
description: gs:// URI of the LLM weights used.

name: env
description: dev | uat | prd — threshold tier applied.

name: num_rows_requested
description: Rows the run was asked to generate.

name: valid_count
description: Rows that passed all Mode-A checks and landed.

name: dlq_count
description: Total dead-lettered records.

name: blocker_count
description: DLQ records whose rule_id is BLOCKER-severity.

name: dlq_by_rule
description: JSON map rule_id -> count (PARSE_JSON to query).

name: blocker_failure_ratio
description: Configured gate for this env (from thresholds.yml).

name: observed_blocker_ratio
description: blocker_count / the rows generated — valid_count + dlq_count, minus the DLQ counts of any excluded_blocker_rules (ADR 0038: an excluded rule leaves BOTH sides of the ratio).

name: status
description: PASSED | FAILED_BLOCKER.

name: excluded_blocker_rules
description: ADR 0038 — rule_ids left out of blocker_count (comma-separated); pk.duplicate on a table whose declared pk: the source disproved.

name: source_repeat_share
description: ADR 0038 — share of the SOURCE child's rows repeating a key value (1 - key_values/children over the fan-out histogram).

name: landing_repeat_share
description: ADR 0038 — pk.duplicate over the rows generated (valid_count + row.duplicate); the landing table's key-repeat share.

name: repeat_share_delta
description: ADR 0038 — landing_repeat_share - source_repeat_share.

name: repeat_share_within_tolerance
description: ADR 0038 — |repeat_share_delta| <= REPEAT_SHARE_TOLERANCE (0.05); NULL when the launch measured no source share for this table.

name: created_at
description: Row write time (UTC); DAY partition key.
